hook: Three strangers, one microphone: keep the voices apart and catch who really does what, and who only wishes they did.
intro: A radio street survey: a presenter and three passers-by — a young woman, an older man and a student — each answering the same question about free time: what they do and what they would like to do more often. Heard once. Radio, podcasts and group conversations all mix several voices, and the skill is keeping the speakers apart: note one keyword per person as they speak (schwimmen / reisen / Freunde). Listen for the Konjunktiv II that marks an unfulfilled wish — Ich würde gern …, aber … — because the aber-clause gives the reason it does not happen, and that reason is always a question. The traps are the activities people mention but do not do regularly.
tips[0].title: One keyword per speaker
tips[0].text: As each person speaks, fix one word: junge Frau → schwimmen (dreimal pro Woche). älterer Mann → reisen (würde gern, aber wenig Geld). Student → Freunde treffen. Then every question is a lookup.
tips[0].check.why: One keyword per speaker: Anna → lesen, Ben → Fußball, Clara → kochen. Fußball is the sport.
tips[1].title: würde gern …, aber … = a wish and its obstacle
tips[1].text: The Konjunktiv says it is not happening; the aber-clause says why. Questions with Warum … nicht? are answered after aber.
tips[1].check.why: würde gern is the wish; the obstacle comes after aber: die Karten sind zu teuer.
tips[1].visual.rows[0].a: Ich würde gern mehr Sport machen,
tips[2].title: Frequency words sort the traps
tips[2].text: dreimal pro Woche, meistens, manchmal, am liebsten, eigentlich: what someone does manchmal or würde gern is not what they do regularly. The wrong options are built from exactly these side remarks.
tips[2].check.why: jeden Morgen means every day; manchmal (sometimes) marks the side activity.
remember[1]: würde gern … aber: wish, then reason.
exam: Matching statements to several speakers is a standard listening task in the B1 exam — the same skill you need to follow a group conversation.
tips[1].check.q: You hear: „Ich würde gern öfter ins Theater gehen, aber die Karten sind zu teuer.“ Why doesn't he go more often?
